app_fee.value: The application fee is $30 and is nonrefundable.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are only for US citizens or permanent residents in certain undergraduate programs; no waiver is available for international students.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers are only available for applicants who are US Citizens or Permanent Residents who were involved in specific programs as undergraduates | No fee waivers are available for international students.

also.quote: Fee waivers exist only under certain circumstances for applicants in programs such as McNair Scholars, FGLSAMP, etc.

gre_general.value: The graduate school leaves GRE rules to each program; ask the program.
gre_general.quote: Ask your program of interest about additional application requirements (e.g. test scores

toefl_min.value: For applications after January 21, 2026, the TOEFL iBT minimum is 4.5 on the new scale.
toefl_min.quote: Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL iBT) after January 21, 2026 ... 4.5 or higher

ielts_min.value: The IELTS Academic minimum is 6.5 overall.
ielts_min.quote: International English Language Testing System (IELTS) ... 6.5 or higher

english_waiver.value: India is not on USF's list of English-speaking countries, and the page names no waiver for an English-medium Indian degree, so a test score is required.
english_waiver.quote: If you are an applicant from a country where English is not the official language, you must also demonstrate proficiency in English by submitting acceptable scores on | Look at the list of English-speaking countries to determine whether you must meet this requirement

notes: Fee waiver: the Civil & Environmental Engineering FAQ states the rule for USF applicants; the graduate pages do not. Engineering and Marine pages describe program-based waivers. Program-level English rules and GRE rules are on each program record. A Geography and Environmental Science and Policy PhD also exists (catalog) but is not saved because the environment field holds one record.
